decision.reason: The only evidence [ev-180d9754a48a] is a one-line changelog bug-fix entry. It says the log results cache now builds empty responses from the request being served. It never names `--cache.enable-results-cache` or any other setting that turns on the log results cache, so the proposed cli-flag condition rests on something the evidence doesn't contain. Deciding exposure would need the PR 11657 diff or the docs that name the config or flag enabling the log results cache. It would also need to say whether exposure depends only on runtime query patterns that return empty cached results.
